# SATRA – Timeline

## Dependencies

-   Node ≥ 18.9.0
-   NPM ≥ 8.19.1

## Getting started

1. Clone the repo (hint: `git clone git@bitbucket.org:digitalsoftware1/timeline-frontend.git`)
2. Ensure you are running the required version of Node/NPM with `nvm use 18.9.0` (assumes you have NVM installed)
3. Install NPM packages with `npm i`
4. Run the frontend application with `npm run watch:app`
5. Run the Storybook application with `npm run watch:storybook`

## Setting up environment variables

1. Copy the `.env.template` file within the root of the application twice
2. Rename one of the copied files to `.env.local`, and the other to `.env.production`
3. The values to set for the appropriate environment files can be found by contacing either Tim or DJ.
